transcription_check.checked_by: Codex translator agent translate_56_75; same agent, not independent expert review
transcription_check.scope: All 20 rendered PDF pages visually inspected and compared with extraction. Images in tmp/pdfs/pages-0592-0611/. Page 596 bold heading and its superscript/footnote apparatus excluded, explicitly preserved below. Parenthesized verse p594:l023 retained. Raw defects and provisional display lineation retained. This checks the defective digital witness, not an original performance or complete critical text.

alignment_check.scope: All 835 source/English pairs read in order, in four complete chunks. Repeated lines, numbers, names, line transitions and source defects checked; lexical and alignment corrections rechecked. No independent expert review.

notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l001: Арбак here is exalted spiritual potency/patronage; not an assertion that the living Manas is a ghost.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l004: The six lions and the youngest position are retained; no list of six historical heroes is supplied. Repeated at l008.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l005: Менде is understood as the epic form of пенде/бенде, mortal or servant of God; raw spelling retained, also l009 and later occurrences.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l007: Телегейи тең is fullness of fortune/prosperity; no material equality claim is intended.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l012: Бейлеп provisionally discerned/considered; the digital reading is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l017: Аманат denotes the entrusted object here, anticipating the heavenly blades, rather than a life entrusted to God.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l020: Күйгөмүн is visibly printed; rendered burning with longing. A possible waiting formula is not silently substituted. Compare l022.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l022: Күйүп retained as yearning/burning; the somewhat awkward construction is not emended to күтүү.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l026: The difficult-to-tell phrase remains a fragmentary assertion; no explanatory story supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l028: Бир буюм, one thing, retained despite six blades below.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l030: Оолукканы here excitement at meeting, not a new madness episode.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l036: Курч literally sharp steel/sharp objects, rendered blades in the ensuing sword context. Six retained throughout.
notes.manas-2010:p0592:b001:l041: The source shifts between plural six blades and singular sword/sheath; English number follows local referents, without inventing distinct named weapons.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l003: Өлчөп literally measuring; deliberately is a provisional contextual rendering of a controlled drawing of the weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l007: Болжош as guiding sign/guide follows Yudakhin, https://el-sozduk.kg/болжо/; revised from a generic aid after lexical checking. Source кирсе lacks the expected second-person ending; context supplies you.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l009: Сан кол is an epic multitude, rendered countless army without assigning an exact historical unit value.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l015: Болот permits steel or will-be; the steel/sharp parallel supports All are steel, all are sharp.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l019: Мураапы is glossed as heir/support in this witness, p1841:b001:l011. Helpers uses the support sense for weapons, not invented human heirs.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l020: Кайып is the unseen/supernatural realm, not a newly introduced place or person here.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l024: Азелде rendered ever/in primordial time; not a date.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l030: Кызырыңдын көзүмүн literally I am the eye/presence of your Kydyr; very presence is interpretive, not a claim of separate divine identity. Кызыр is standardized Kydyr.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l036: The upright back bending is a figure of adversity/weakness; paired with life being pressed in l038–039.
notes.manas-2010:p0593:b001:l038: Fly-like wretched life preserves the diminutive life image.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l001: Weapons require blood before returning to their sheaths; supernatural violence retained literally through l004.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l009: Кындуу ыктуусу is provisionally a well-fitted sheathed sword; precise epithet relation remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l014: Zulpukor is retained as the named sword, also glossed in this witness p1838. Not identified with a specific surviving artifact.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l023: Parenthesized Kara dindüü köp kalyk is visually part of the verse block. Kept as an interrupting verse fragment; dark faith is the source characterization, with uncertain syntactic attachment.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l026: Зайыппуруш is a world-conquering hero title, following local glossary p1842:l016–019; not a proper name. Conditional болбосо preserved in final alignment correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l030: Мубарбек visibly printed; interpreted through the blessing/mubarak formula, with no silent source normalization.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l031: Өзү тийген may refer to the blade striking the mighty; English pronoun chosen from weapon context, qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l035: The six blades are said to be suited to their adversaries; no modern ethnic claim is inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l038: Death is the condition before giving away the sword in l039–040, not a present command to surrender it.
notes.manas-2010:p0594:b001:l042: Күлдөй visibly printed. Whole provisionally connects it with күлдү, all (Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/КҮЛДҮ/); an ash-like reading is possible. Raw retained; specialist review needed.
notes.manas-2010:p0595:b001:l001: Кыраан is hunting-bird/hero imagery; thousand falcon heroes retains both the number and heroic sense, not a zoological count.
notes.manas-2010:p0595:b001:l007: Baabedin retained as a sacred patron name; no new historical identification supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0595:b001:l012: Forty places and forty companions retained, together with the repeated forty in l013–017.
notes.manas-2010:p0595:b001:l013: Чоро эмес...кырк жоро is a contrast between warrior companions and friends. More than is qualitative here, not more than forty persons.
notes.manas-2010:p0595:b001:l017: Forty different dispositions/ways, one for each companion; repetition retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0595:b001:l021: These refers contextually to the blades, to be stored until their owners are found at l024–025.
notes.manas-2010:p0595:b001:l032: Дубана is a wandering holy man; not insanity in this context.
notes.manas-2010:p0595:b001:l035: Кадуулай means traveling along a mountain slope (Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/к/). Initial nonstop reading corrected; Manas and now restored in alignment.
notes.manas-2010:p0595:b001:l039: Becoming a lion is retained as source heroic imagery, not a literal species change asserted by the translator.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b001:l003: Ой тартып interpreted as moving toward the lowland, though thinking/turning thoughts is lexically possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b001:l005: Кымыз is fermented mare milk. Girls by night retains the sexual allusion without inventing specific acts.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b001:l012: Ордо is the knucklebone game; forty таман rendered paces, no metric conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b001:l014: Кысыр тай is a yearling whose dam was barren that year, not a sterile yearling; Yudakhin example under https://el-sozduk.kg/sut-5/.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b001:l015: Бор кайнат means boil thoroughly/until tender; local glossary p1836:l007 and https://el-sozduk.kg/bor-6/.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b001:l016: Коштон кийип суусар бөрк has an uncertain doubling/distributive force. Double marten-fur caps preserves it provisionally; exact construction needs review.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b001:l017: Ыргап, swaying, is visibly printed and retained; not silently changed to жыргап, enjoying, as in l019.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b003:l002: Кула is the dun horse; source shortening of Akkula retained as color rather than creating a new horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b003:l006: Төрт айлана understood as all four sides with the preceding four corners, not an invented count of four repeated circuits.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b003:l009: Self-curse to die unworthy of the name Manas retained; repeated curses later are not abridged.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b003:l011: Ат бороюн follows local glossary Атборой, whole earth, p1834:l022; not interpreted as merely tiring a horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b003:l015: This long display line remains one translation row; continuation paternal kin is the next source line.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b003:l017: Түмөн retained as tümen, an epic large-number unit without imposed exact count.
notes.manas-2010:p0596:b003:l018: Жылма болгон малымда provisionally among my sleek herds; source form and the following contradiction are retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l001: No steed to ride is retained despite the preceding abundant horses and the immediate mention of Akkula. No narrative harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l004: Короолоп кеткен айылы жок provisionally no village where they have gathered; the household/fold verb is uncertain here.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l005: Кордолуп is interpreted humiliation; raw printed form is not rewritten.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l007: Тоорул scout/raiding ride, not a named destination.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l020: Медерим is support, contextually the lost kin; no individual name supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l021: Бейпайда means uselessly here; not silently altered to бейпай.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l023: Keeping the God-given life alone is the source rhetorical thought; no missing relative supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l030: Түйшүгү кымбат, literally precious burden/trouble, retained as an unusual tulpar epithet. Exact intended praise remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l033: Eight kin explicitly retained; not reconciled with other genealogical counts.
notes.manas-2010:p0597:b001:l035: Кун is blood-price/vengeance; pursue blood-price retains the customary idiom without a modern legal equivalence.
notes.manas-2010:p0598:b001:l003: Half a mountain retained, though a middling-height description follows on p601.
notes.manas-2010:p0598:b001:l006: Бербердигер жараткан provisionally sustaining Creator, an apparent Parvardigar-type divine epithet. Exact spelling not independently located in the queried dictionary. Not confused with бардигер meaning all/existing in strength-gathering formulas.
notes.manas-2010:p0598:b001:l010: Акка мойнум бурбасам literally turning the neck toward the Truth/God, also a death euphemism. Deliberately kept close to the image; explicit death parallel at l042.
notes.manas-2010:p0598:b001:l021: Белгиленсе visibly printed; braced himself is a tentative bodily-context reading, possibly defective form. Strength emerging is secure.
notes.manas-2010:p0598:b001:l023: Hair sufficient for five felt stockings is retained as grotesque heroic hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p0598:b001:l030: Көрсө көңүл бөлүнүп leaves the experiencer implicit; English takes the sight of him as stirring/shaking the observer.
notes.manas-2010:p0598:b001:l035: Wisdom from the unseen retained; no editorial rationalization.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l003: Атам can include forefather; father Karakan preserves the address without silently replacing it with a reconstructed genealogy.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l004: Кан талоон is mass plunder of a dead khan or defeated enemy, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/taloon/. Khan possessions follows the preceding death context.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l011: Face of Judgment Day is the source image for extreme suffering; literal eschatological imagery retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l017: Бөөдөй кууруу means merciless destruction per local glossary p1835:l034; not literal roasting like fleas.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l018: Карап кылуу means devastate/ruin per local glossary p1840:l017–018, not looking at the people.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l021: Nails touching and eyes seeing retained as reach/contact imagery; precise formula scope remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l023: The participial plundering sequence may describe the enemy who took the kin, or the speaker’s projected retaliation. English preserves its suspended participial form.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l033: Peoples with princely courts is the object of dividing; English does not recast it as sharing palaces.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l035: Twelve months and repeated dying in battle retained as source hyperbole, not corrected to merely fighting.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l039: Zhelpinish is the named distant end-of-earth place; no modern geographic identification asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0599:b001:l040: Seven circuits retained as explicit epic repetition, unlike the four-direction formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0600:b001:l008: Малдан ачып баарды visibly printed. Opening all livestock wealth is provisional; a lost consonant in a scattering-wealth formula is possible, but raw is not changed.
notes.manas-2010:p0600:b001:l015: Ат тулпарын is horse/tulpar here, unlike ат бороюн, whole earth, on p596 and p611.
notes.manas-2010:p0600:b001:l023: Чалыш rendered struggle in the conquest context; tripping/wrestling sense may underlie it.
notes.manas-2010:p0600:b001:l024: Тил билбеген is not understanding words/language, contextually not obeying; the less coercively paraphrased wording is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0600:b001:l029: The sole-horse owner’s horse is killed; no exception or mercy added. Lines l037–038 repeat the pattern with a lone person.
notes.manas-2010:p0600:b001:l031: Жетпес эл provisionally people lacking sufficient food/means, not an exact class label. Verb feeding secure.
notes.manas-2010:p0600:b001:l038: Slaughtering the lone person and feasting/sating oneself is retained without sanitizing the threat.
notes.manas-2010:p0600:b001:l039: Beijing and Mecca appear together in the source; no geography correction or religious motive is supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0601:b001:l014: Wings weary and feet reach is an awkward combined distance formula, retained without inserting a missing negative.
notes.manas-2010:p0601:b001:l016: Kara-Kyr retained as a city name; no modern location asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0601:b001:l017: Kap is the mythic mountain name; not silently localized to the Caucasus.
notes.manas-2010:p0601:b001:l030: Middling height retained despite mountain-sized descriptions before and after.
notes.manas-2010:p0601:b001:l035: Seven interpreted as age from the possessive/ablative childhood context; number unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0601:b001:l041: Кантип иер экен is uncertain, plausibly how he will turn/deal with them. What will he do to us is contextual, not a certain restoration.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l004: Setting the unsettled people straight is their fear of compulsory mustering, carried by l005–008; madness retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l009: From ill-intentioned Jakyp is a visibly abrupt fragment. The relation to Manas in l011 is implied but no missing son-of clause is manufactured.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l018: Өңгүл-дөңгүл rendered broken uneven speech; retains the irregularity image.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l024: Быйыл, this year, explicitly retained, even though this opening is unusual.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l026: Мурас is inheritance/legacy; the rhetorical question does not introduce a new physical inheritance.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l028: Four sides/directions, paired with the four corners, rather than four repeated circuits.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l030: Жетик желек is provisionally fine/complete pennon; сыр найза painted spear. Exact epithet force remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l034: Жекене rendered leather belt after Kyrgyz explanatory dictionary with the exact girding formula: https://el-sozduk.kg/жекен/.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l036: Доо visibly printed; giants is a contextual reading as дөө in the earth-bending battle formula. Raw not silently corrected.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l038: Учмактуу provisionally heavenly/paradisal; exact city epithet needs specialist review, no city name invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0602:b001:l042: Death shared and life joined continues into p603’s search for close companions.
notes.manas-2010:p0603:b001:l015: The narrator says Manas cannot remain without slaughterous combat with peoples; retained alongside his promise not to burden his own people.
notes.manas-2010:p0603:b001:l020: Амаз visibly lacks the initial н; prayers reads the contextual намаз formula. Raw defect retained in extraction.
notes.manas-2010:p0603:b001:l022: Жайланып taken as preparing/settling his equipment rather than becoming emotionally calm while furious.
notes.manas-2010:p0603:b001:l026: Кызык кырдуу literally wondrous-faceted; not silently changed to кызыл, red.
notes.manas-2010:p0603:b001:l029: Ач билек provisionally bare wrist/forearm; exact anatomical epithet uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0603:b001:l030: Plane tree planted in Talas is praise of Manas, followed by his mount/throne image; no actual planting event supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0603:b001:l032: Camel-sized golden throne is the mount image; kept rather than replacing with an ordinary saddle.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l001: Right shoulder blade explicitly retained rather than silently plural broad shoulders.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l002: Twelve members retains the traditional body-member formula without modern anatomical reconstruction.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l004: Ойрот retained as Oirat, an ethnonym; may also function as a broad world/realm term in epic diction.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l008: Ninety mountains retained exactly; no rounding to many.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l010: Буй кылып provisionally make turmoil; compressed phrase is qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l012: The iron shield/steel clothing construction is elliptical. With an iron shield, in steel spans the ensuing arming line.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l014: Eighteen thousand worlds is the source cosmological number, not eighteen thousand soldiers.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l022: Заар force rendered wrath/ferocity, rather than literal poison in this character appraisal.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l026: Кула rendered dun steed, the source abbreviated horse designation; no new horse introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p0604:b001:l042: Доо here trouble/claim is plausible, unlike the earth-bending дөө correction on p602. Kept broad as trouble.
notes.manas-2010:p0605:b001:l006: Winged creature and whip-bearer preserve the parallel protection formula without rationalizing its first member.
notes.manas-2010:p0605:b001:l013: Туйгун тууган кабылан preserves mixed falcon/leopard praise; тууган is born here, not a kinsman reference.
notes.manas-2010:p0605:b001:l022: Creator addressed directly, with life condition retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0605:b001:l023: Keng-Kol and Talas retained as places; no modern boundary assignment.
notes.manas-2010:p0605:b001:l029: Оомийин rendered Amen; spreading palms is the source prayer gesture.
notes.manas-2010:p0605:b001:l033: Sixty worries at once retained as stated number.
notes.manas-2010:p0605:b001:l034: Twelve is age, retained despite earlier age-seven feats.
notes.manas-2010:p0605:b001:l038: Басып, жеке журтуна is awkward; provisionally relates the departing hero to concern for his own people in l039. No missing verse supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l004: Түш can mean dream/fortune or situation. Fortune is provisional in the community’s fear of disaster.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l009: Көөсөр simple/foolish; simple preserves the narrator’s disparaging tone mildly, not a tribal name.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l012: Жин visibly printed; spilled rage retains that reading. Жын, stomach contents, is a possible variant in a violent excess formula; not silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l013: Flourishing whenever depleted and growing stronger whenever dead are retained paradoxes, not rewritten as surviving.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l019: A sheepfold’s worth of red willows preserves the spatial growth comparison and miraculous rapidity.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l020: Кожосан is a hero-protecting spirit, explicitly glossed at p1839:l019; revised to protected by Kozhosan rather than generic sacred stature.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l021: Кожо rendered Holy, Kydyr retained as patron name; helper sense of жар, not wife.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l030: Көйкашка laudatory peerless/bold hero, not a proper name.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l037: Unsheathed sword is expressly stated; not put into a sheath by translator for practical consistency.
notes.manas-2010:p0606:b001:l039: Again-raining cloud image retained; whether кайра modifies the subsequent survey is not fully secure.
notes.manas-2010:p0607:b001:l003: Zhorgonun-Bel retained as the named pass; no modern geolocation.
notes.manas-2010:p0607:b001:l011: Жер соорусу choicest/best part of the land, literally land’s rump/back; recurring landscape praise.
notes.manas-2010:p0607:b001:l014: Жаныбар is affectionate wonder in this landscape apostrophe, not necessarily addressing a newly appearing animal.
notes.manas-2010:p0607:b001:l018: Кулан rendered wild ass, not horse foal.
notes.manas-2010:p0607:b001:l027: Бөөт-бөөт provisional rounded/rolling ridges; repetition preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0607:b001:l038: Sary Özön retained as named valley; not replaced by a modern administrative name.
notes.manas-2010:p0607:b001:l041: Машайык rendered holy elders, distinguished from saints/олуя in following line.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l002: Oluya-Ata is the narrated place-name explanation; not an independent historical etymology claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l004: Ийини тозуп literally shoulders worn, understood as ragged clothing; hunger remains literal.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l008: Карып-кашар helpless/poor people; no occupational class invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l013: Тунбайбы rendered find peace/settle, retaining the rhetorical question.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l017: Казы is horse belly fat; карыш a span. No exact measurement conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l023: Жаңырыктын Жар-Кыя retained as Zhangyryk’s Zhar-Kyya from capitalization/context; it could also carry echoing-cliff description. No map identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l024: Жалгыз аттын чубама provisionally narrow single-horse trail; fragmentary noun construction retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l027: Айдай moon-like retained alongside yellow plain; no silent change to ordinary broad plain.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l034: Жалаңкыч rendered devourer, a fearsome epithet; not a named new character.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l035: Bull neck and male-camel thighs retain the animal-body comparisons.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l037: Күрмө калкандай uncertain shield/vest comparison. Күрмө is sleeveless garment per local p1839:l039 and https://el-sozduk.kg/күрмө/. Both vest and shield retained; exact compound construction unresolved within a defensible literal line.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l039: Өтөк is a former camp/sheepfold site with rich soil; nettles retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0608:b001:l042: Biting through the lip retains the source violent facial image; not toned down to pursing lips.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l003: Көк horse color rendered gray; тулпар remains epic steed term, not a named horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l007: Көк сүлөөсүн interpreted gray lynx fur, no specific zoological subspecies asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l010: Twelve batman retained without conversion; чоюн баш is cast-iron-headed mace in weapon context.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l018: Eyelashes compared with greasy axe handle retained, however physically excessive.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l019: Bakay is named by narrator before Manas learns his identity; source reveal not delayed or removed.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l023: Кууганы visibly pursued/drove away, not the more expected begotten formula. Pursued me is provisional; no silent correction to туулган/туудурган.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l025: Altay spelling standardized within this batch; no identity change.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l029: Burut retained as the source exonym applied to Manas by Chinese adversaries.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l031: Тең көрдүм can mean saw as equal/all alike; as equals follows the hero’s comparison, not a claim of equal numbers.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l033: Калдай rendered governor rank using shared lexicon; not treated as a new named person.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l034: Күрмө is vest/sleeveless garment; armored is contextual for strong combatants and remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0609:b001:l036: Have not met death and died is retained although tautological.
notes.manas-2010:p0610:b001:l003: Half a mountain repeated from initial appearance; no abridgment of repeated portrait.
notes.manas-2010:p0610:b001:l006: Бадирек can mean wicked/brutish or fearless hero per local p1834:l034–037. Fierce brute preserves Manas’s alarm while allowing the praise context.
notes.manas-2010:p0610:b001:l012: Албандык is might/grandeur, paired with балбандык prowess below; no tax or levy sense intended here.
notes.manas-2010:p0610:b001:l023: Акжолтой good-fortune-bringing, not proper name Akzholtoy.
notes.manas-2010:p0610:b001:l029: Shared sheepfold, feast, treasury, faith and battle sequence retained line for line as imagined friendship.
notes.manas-2010:p0610:b001:l035: Ыймандаш sharing faith, especially in death; could include performing last religious duties, not expanded into a full funeral rite.
notes.manas-2010:p0610:b001:l038: Wide river camping-ground metaphor retained amid the proposed bond, no geographic place invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0611:b001:l002: Battle cry asks lineage/allegiance, alongside origin; source closes quotation early, but thought continues. English quote scope follows syntax.
notes.manas-2010:p0611:b001:l004: Kakan-Chin retained as source place designation; not a historical state reconstruction.
notes.manas-2010:p0611:b001:l006: Repeated дин faith and ыйман retained as faith of Islam without conflating this question with known identity.
notes.manas-2010:p0611:b001:l020: Каркыбар is laudatory mighty fellow, not a name, per Kyrgyz explanatory dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/карк/.
notes.manas-2010:p0611:b001:l025: Ат бороюн whole earth follows local glossary p1834:l022; repeats p596 wording, not merely wearing down a horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0611:b001:l031: Алдынан visibly third-person form amid first-person wish; beneath me is contextual to Бууданым my steed, with raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0611:b001:l032: Bakay as tireless swift steed is Manas’s hoped-for support metaphor, not a request to acquire Bakay’s horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0611:b001:l035: Акыреттик дос friendship extending into the hereafter retained, not merely lifelong friendship.
notes.manas-2010:p0611:b001:l042: God striking down is a prospective curse/disaster question after jousting; us supplied contextually, with source object implicit. Thought continues after batch end.
